articles.summary: In this case study, we highlight how Microsoft Research used our automated lab to validate proteins generated by EvoDiff, their novel sequence-first protein design model, in just a few weeks.
articles.title: Case study: Validating proteins designed by Microsoft Research’s EvoDiff
